item.title: Weird Fish delivers record Christmas and full year performance
item.description: British lifestyle, clothing and accessories brand Weird Fish has reported it strongest ever Christmas and fourth quarter (Q4) performance. In a financial report released today (3 February), the business said total sales in November and December increased by 18.4% to £13.5 million (2024: £11.4 million). item.title: Kingfisher appoints Ocado CFO as non executive
item.description: Kingfisher has appointed Ocado chief financial officer (CFO) Stephen Daintith as a non-executive director and member of the company’s audit and nomination committees.

item.title: M&S kidswear director departs after six years
item.description: M&S kidswear director Alex Dimitriu has stepped down from the company after six years.

item.title: Booths names new CEO amid leadership shake-up
item.description: Booths has appointed Nigel Murray as its new chief executive, following the decision by Edwin Booth to step down from the role while retaining his position as chairman.
